success.description: # You hit the target for normal damage.

boon.description: You may add 2 recharge tokens to the card.

conservative.requirements: Two-handed weapon equipped, engaged with target. If your armour soak value is 3 or greater, add {Dc} to the dice pool. Effect: You use the weight and momentum of your weapon and armour to smash your enemies. While this action is recharging, you may disengage from enemies for free (effectively moving as if you were not engaged with them) and your Melee Attacks deal +1 damage per Zweihander card you have recharging.

success.description: You hit the target for normal damage.

boon.description: While this action is recharging, your attacks gain Pierce 1.

reckless.requirements: Two-handed weapon equipped, engaged with target. Special: If your target’s armour soak value is 3 or greater, add {Dc} to the dice pool. Effect: You use the weight and momentum of your weapon and armour to smash through your enemies. While this action is recharging, you may disengage from enemies for free (effectively moving as if you were not engaged with them) and your Melee Attacks deal +1 damage per Zweihander card you have recharging.
